text: Account: Meridian Health Systems. Stage: discovery. Key contact: Priya Shah, VP of Revenue Operations. Last interaction: Priya described inconsistent answers during clinical software demos and agreed to share five anonymized objection examples for a focused pilot.

Account: Copperline Logistics. Stage: evaluation. Key contact: Marcus Lee, Director of Sales Enablement. Last interaction: Marcus completed a search walkthrough and asked for a comparison against ReplyGrid, with special attention to onboarding time and manager reporting.

Account: Juniper Home. Stage: proposal. Key contact: Elena Rossi, Chief Customer Officer. Last interaction: Elena accepted the Growth tier proposal but requested annual prepayment terms and a written adoption milestone before procurement begins its review.

Account: Fieldstone Analytics. Stage: security review. Key contact: Daniel Okafor, Head of IT. Last interaction: Daniel received the data handling questionnaire and is waiting for details on retention controls, SSO, and whether the pilot can use a restricted knowledge space.

Account: Harbor & Pine Retail. Stage: closed won. Key contact: Tessa Nguyen, Sales Enablement Manager. Last interaction: Tessa confirmed the first rollout to the specialty retail team and scheduled a 30-day review focused on objection handling, search quality, and weekly active users.
